Indicator: Percentage compliance to the DOD Information and Communication Technology Implementation Plan
ReasonforDeviation_Summary:
The underachievement of 10.36% can be attributed to: 
•	Late appointment of SITA resources in the CMIS Project environment.
•	SITA Supply Chain Management delays.  
•	Research Data Centre Corporate Data Centre Refurbishment delays at the Development Bank of South Africa impacted the relocation of the Primary Corporate Data Centre.     
•	Penetration tests not performed.  
•	Security assessment of the DOD ICT supply chain process was not conducted due to a shortage of internal CMIS resources. 
•	Forward Air Control and Mission Control Proof of Concepts were delayed due to the unavailability of SA Air Force Platform
CorrectiveAction_Summary: Target achievement to be pursued in future planning instruments.
ReasonforDeviation_Q1:
Q1 underachievement is due to:
* The late appointment of SITA resources (9 of the 17 have been staffed) and dependencies on SITA
procurement processes.
* The DIW was informed that penetration testing is the responsibility of Defence Intelligence and therefor
the penetration testing was not performed.
*Theft of 4 Computers at DOD Archives on 18 Jun 2022 influenced the attainment of the Anti-Criminality
target.
* The Draft Digital Strategy was completed but is currently realigned with international standards and a
new format has been identified.
* Quality Control for the Electromagnetic Spectrum Management policy in process, feedback wrt the
historic debt delayed the policy process.
* The spare identifications and stores arrangements for NTBI has not been finalised in Q1.
CorrectiveAction_Q1:
Early warning aspects are addressed in detail in the main document and will be presented at the July
DPBEC.
SITA is continuing with the appointment process to enable the availability of required ICT resources.
ReasonforDeviation_Q2:
Q2 underachievement due to:
* The late appointment of SITA resources and dependencies on the SITA procurement processes.
* Only 10 of the 17 SITA Project resources have been staffed.
* The delay in the acquisition process of the Isilon and Data Domain, the process commenced and will be
finalised by November 2022.
* Blenny Relocation – The DELL and CISCO tender procurement process was cancelled and then
republished thus causing project delays. December target date is still achievable.
* NTBI Training that was rescheduled and will be done in Q3.This is due to change in approval of the route
to be taken for NTBI training.
* FAC and Mission Control POC’s could not be executed due to unavailability of Platforms
* No assessment in relation to ICT supply chain process were conducted
* The CMIS Div was informed that penetration testing is the responsibility of Defence Intelligence and
therefor the penetration testing was not performed.
CorrectiveAction_Q2:
* SITA is continuing with the appointment process to enable the availability of required ICT resources, it is
managed at the DOD and SITA Steering Committee.
* Training plan was amended and will be implemented in Q3.
* Awaiting confirmation from SAAF.
* Additional personnel were allocated to execute this task in Q3. Identified tasks that were not completed in
Q1 and Q2 will be addressed.
* Assessment of Penetration test requirement will be finalised in Q3 and submitted to CDI to enable
penetration test to be scheduled for FY2023/24.
* Early warning aspects are addressed in the main document.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3:
Q3 underachievement is due to:
• The Risk training for the CMIS Div and ICT representatives were scheduled for 1 Dec 22 but was cancelled by DRM.
• SITA Resources only achieved 76% based on the fact that not all posts have been staffed (13/17).
• Generator and UPS still outstanding. UPS will be delivered in Jan 23. Requirement for generator for standby power was set to ARMSCOR
• Interoperability Measurement of the Oryx / Gripen ( Data Capture and Re-capture on Operational Platforms) was scheduled for next quarter, but was already partially completed (70%) in this reporting period and therefore the over achievement of 3% in this environment.
• Members that were identified from SACSA were not properly qualified to be considered for this training. As such the Training could not continue. The plan is to identify members from the Services and Divisions for suitable candidates.
• Gaps in the research has been identified to fulfil the initial requirements to address the entire Supply Chain process.
CorrectiveAction_Q3: Identified gaps will be addressed in Q4.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4: None. Q4 target achieved.

•	These issues primarily related to the use of QLFS from StatsSA and changes to the collection method of this data to telephonic surveys as a result of the Covid-19.
